method: Official pages independently opened via web tool; browser destination checks recorded separately. No provider lookup or regulatory transaction.

florida.agency: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation
florida.title: Verify a Licensee
florida.purpose: Search DBPR-regulated individuals and businesses by name, license number or license type.
florida.limitation: Not every Florida trade is regulated by DBPR. Select the relevant board and credential class; this link is not a completed status check.
florida.deepLink: Search landing only; no individual credential parameters added.

texas.agency: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
texas.title: TDLR Active License Search
texas.purpose: Search active TDLR specialty licenses, including air conditioning and electrical.
texas.limitation: Not a general-contractor registry or a plumbing-board search. Absence from this active-only search does not establish that no credential ever existed.
texas.deepLink: Search landing only; no individual credential parameters added.

texasGc.title: Contractor Registration
texasGc.purpose: Official explanation of Texas general-contractor licensing and Austin building/trade contractor registration.
texasGc.limitation: Austin registration procedures apply to Austin; confirm requirements with the authority for the actual project location. Not a contractor status lookup.
texasGc.deepLink: Information landing page; no transaction or registration form is submitted.

california.title: Check A License
california.purpose: Check a California contractor license using its number or business name.
california.limitation: A license search does not establish availability or Los Angeles service territory. No individual official lookup has been performed here.
california.deepLink: Verified generic license-search page; no invented provider parameters.

alaskaElevator.agency: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Mechanical Inspection
alaskaElevator.title: Elevators, Escalators, Wheel-Chair Lifts, and Dumbwaiters
alaskaElevator.purpose: Elevator equipment oversight, inspection requirements and the responsible inspection contact; the page identifies Anchorage inspection responsibility separately.
alaskaElevator.limitation: Equipment inspection or a Certificate of Operation is not proof of a contractor business license, individual qualification or approval.
alaskaElevator.deepLink: Information landing page only; no equipment or contractor lookup parameters.
